PublicBundleDescription: Select a public catalog to import into your new account. This will start you off with a ready-to-use speaking account.
PublicBundleLevelADescription: This basic vocabulary is intentionally limited and designed to be expanded by a healthcare professional, ideally a speech therapist. However, it allows users to become familiar with Pictalk fundamentals. Recommended for beginners in AAC, it avoids cognitive overload by limiting the number of pictograms initially.
PublicBundleLevelBDescription: This much richer vocabulary provides a solid foundation for users already familiar with pictograms and having some prior vocabulary knowledge. It is ideal for those looking for more fluid and varied communication.

TutorialsCreationText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to create, edit, and delete pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will know how to create a new collection and add pictograms to it. You will also see how to edit an image in Pictalk.

TutorialsOrganizingText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to organize pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will easily master Pictalk’s most powerful organization tools, like drag and drop.

TutorialsSharingText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to share pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will know how to share a collection with other users and how to integrate shared collections into your personal space.

TitleCompleteKeywords: Speak with pictograms for autism and more
DescriptionSEO: Pictalk helps people with physical or mental disabilities communicate using pictograms and images. These can include: Autism, Down syndrome, apraxia, stroke, and more.
PopupCreateAccountText6: No limit on space or pictograms 💾

ErrorSubtitle: Sometimes things don't go as planned and errors happen, especially after updates. Please note that bugs are automatically reported to us. If the issue continues, email us or join us on Facebook or Instagram. Click the button below to try fixing the error.
DonationText1:
Thank you for using Pictalk! 🙏

10,000 of you communicate thanks to this free app.

$5/month = One family that keeps access to servers and new features.

No ads, no shareholders. Just families supporting each other.
DonationText2:
Pictalk is free because 200 families give for 10,000.
Join this supportive community.
Your contribution funds the servers, development, and keeps the app 100% accessible.
$5/month or $50/year = Real impact.
DonationText3:
How does Pictalk stay free?

✅ No ads
✅ No shareholders
✅ A community of families who give according to their means

Can you help? $5/month is enough to maintain the service for hundreds of families.
DonationText4:
Communication is a right, not a privilege.
We created Pictalk for Pablo, our non-verbal little brother. Today, 10,000 people use it for free.
Help us keep this promise. Even $5/month makes a difference

membership-step1-title: We've been moving forward together for a while.
membership-step1-body: You, those you support, and Pictalk — every day, every pictogram.
membership-step1-quote: “Thanks to Pictalk, my student was able to express themselves for the first time at 12 years old.”
membership-step2-body: Pictalk has been free since day one. Zero advertising. Zero exploitation of your data. But behind the scenes, there are servers, developers, updates — and it has a real cost.
membership-step3-title: What if your institution took over?
membership-step3-body: You don't have to decide alone. But you can start the conversation.
membership-pill1-body: We prepare a clear dossier for you to pass on when the opportunity arises.
membership-pill2-title: Have you ever wondered what an alternative would cost?
membership-pill2-body: How much would a market solution cost without the solidarity model if Pictalk disappeared
membership-pill3-body: You unlock sharing, groups, and more. And Pictalk continues.
membership-book-call: Book 30 min with the Pictalk team
membership-reason-direction: My management makes the decisions, not me
followup-step1-title: Have you been able to discuss it with your management?
followup-step1-body: A few days ago, you accessed the Pictalk presentation folder. We just wanted to check in.
followup-option-not-yet-body: I haven't had the chance yet.
followup-not-yet-title: When you're ready, everything is here.
followup-not-yet-body: The folder is ready to send to your management. It takes 2 minutes — when the time is right.
followup-sent-body: It's often the hardest part. If your management has questions, we can step in directly — a 30-minute call is enough to sort everything out.
followup-sent-quote: “My director had questions about the budget. The Pictalk team answered everything in 20 minutes.”
followup-book-call: Book 30 min with the Pictalk team
followup-wait-response: Let's wait for their response first
followup-direction-positive-body: Interested or ready to move forward.
followup-direction-negative-body: It's not the right time for them.
followup-positive-body: We take 30 minutes with you and your management to answer all questions and set up the membership.
followup-hesitant-title: We know these questions by heart.
followup-hesitant-body: We can help you: budget, associative model, technical questions — One call is enough.
followup-book-call-direction: Book a call with your management
followup-negative-body: Pictalk remains available for you and your patients. If the situation changes, come back anytime.
followup-negative-feedback-label: Do you know what was the blocker? (optional)
followup-joined-title: Your institution is among those making this possible
followup-joined-body: Thanks to you, Pictalk continues — and families and professionals can keep relying on it. Pro features will be available to you in advance.
followup-joined-cta: Thank you — back to the application
